method.inventory: All Markdown files recursively in folders 01–07; empty means whitespace only.
method.links: Inline Markdown links scanned for missing local paths; repeated occurrences counted separately. Does not validate external URLs, anchors, raw HTML images or all Markdown syntax. Missing paths checked on authoring filesystem; exact-case checks for authored 04–07 also covered by existing checker.
method.shell: bash -n on fenced bash/sh blocks in folders 01–03 using authoring Bash 3.2.57. Fragments, intentional errors and unsupported newer syntax are flags, not confirmed runnable-script defects. No documented command executed by this scan.
method.editorial: Selected entry pages, storage/safety examples and project introductions inspected; not a line-by-line technical certification of every lesson/project.
